summary: The proof is correct within its stated fan-transverse local stratum. The vertex-area differential and complete rank-defect classification are valid; the 3+3 annihilator is correctly shown to have trivial intersection with the relevant four-dimensional sector-weight space; the active constraints satisfy LICQ; the multiplier for d >= 4/9 has the correct nonnegative sign and enters stationarity with coefficient -mu; active centroid inequalities are correctly excluded using the planar 4/9 centroid halfplane bound and monotonicity of Phi; and the accepted triangle facts apply exactly to both parity classes, including their stated boundary-ray closures. The proof makes no unsupported global-attainment or nonsmooth higher-polygon claim.
